        "contents": "// MARK: - Group Edit Sheet Container\n\nstruct Mac_GroupEditSheetContainer: View {\n    @ObservedObject var group: DeviceGroup\n    let onCancel: () -&gt; Void\n    let onSave: () -&gt; Void\n\n    @Environment(\\.dismiss) private var dismiss\n\n    @State private var originalGroupName: String = \"\"\n    @State private var originalDeviceIDs: Set&lt;String&gt; = []\n\n    var body: some View {\n        NavigationStack {\n            Mac_GroupDetailView(group: group, showsDoneButton: false)\n                .navigationTitle(group.groupName)\n                .toolbar {\n                    ToolbarItem(placement: .cancellationAction) {\n                        Button(NSLocalizedString(\"cancel\", comment: \"Cancel editing the group\")) {\n                            group.groupName = originalGroupName\n                            group.deviceIDs = originalDeviceIDs\n                            dismiss()\n                            onCancel()\n                        }\n                    }\n                    ToolbarItem(placement: .confirmationAction) {\n                        Button(NSLocalizedString(\"save\", comment: \"Save changes to the group\")) {\n                            dismiss()\n                            onSave()\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                .onAppear {\n                    originalGroupName = group.groupName\n                    originalDeviceIDs = group.deviceIDs\n                }\n        }\n        .frame(minWidth: 500, minHeight: 600)\n    }\n}\n\n#Preview {\n    let groupStore = DeviceGroupStore.shared\n    groupStore.groups = [\n        DeviceGroup(name: \"Family\"),\n        DeviceGroup(name: \"Work\"),\n        DeviceGroup(name: \"Friends\")\n    ]\n    return Mac_GroupsView().environmentObject(groupStore)\n}",

        "contents": "    }\n    \n    // Tracking-Modus-Text\n    private var trackingModeText: String {\n        return NSLocalizedString(\"Tracking mode: Live (GPS) - Foreground only on macOS\", comment: \"Tracking mode text for macOS\")\n    }\n    \n    // Log der letzten Updates\n    private var updateLog: [LocationManager.UpdateLogEntry] {\n        locationManager.updateLog\n    }\n\n    private func speedText(for location: CLLocation) -&gt; String {\n        let metersPerSecond = location.speed\n        if metersPerSecond &gt;= 0 {\n            let kilometersPerHour = metersPerSecond * 3.6\n            return String(format: \"%.1f km/h\", kilometersPerHour)\n        } else {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"Unknown\", comment: \"Unknown speed value in Location Tracking Details\")\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func altitudeText(for location: CLLocation) -&gt; String {\n        let verticalAccuracy = location.verticalAccuracy\n        if verticalAccuracy &gt;= 0 {\n            return String(format: \"%.1f m\", location.altitude)\n        } else {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"Unknown\", comment: \"Unknown altitude value in Location Tracking Details\")\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// MARK: - Supporting Views (reused from iPhone version)\nstruct Mac_LocationInfoRow: View {\n    let title: String\n    let value: String\n    let icon: String\n    \n    var body: some View {\n        HStack {\n            Image(systemName: icon)\n                .foregroundColor(.blue)\n                .frame(width: 20)\n            \n            Text(title)\n                .font(.caption)\n                .foregroundColor(.secondary)\n            \n            Spacer()\n            \n            Text(value)\n                .font(.caption)\n                .fontWeight(.medium)\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nstruct Mac_ServerStatusRow: View {\n    let status: LocationManager.ServerUpdateStatus",

Created native Mac onboarding views. Summary:

1. Created 6 Mac onboarding views in `/miataru/views/Mac/Onboarding/`:
   - `Mac_1_OnboardingWelcomeView.swift` — Welcome screen
   - `Mac_2_OnboardingLocationPermissionView.swift` — Location permissions
   - `Mac_3_OnboardingServerView.swift` — Server selection
   - `Mac_4_OnboardingLocationHistoryView.swift` — Location history settings
   - `Mac_5_OnboardingQRcodeView.swift` — QR code info
   - `Mac_6_OnboardingDoneView.swift` — Completion screen

2. Updated `Mac_OnboardingContainerView.swift` to use the Mac views instead of the iPhone views.

All views:
- Wrapped in `#if os(macOS)` for macOS-only compilation
- Use `NSColor.controlBackgroundColor` for Mac styling
- Adapted text from "Swipe left" to "Click Next" for Mac
- Removed iOS-specific keyboard handling from the server view
- Maintain the same functionality as the iPhone versions

The linter shows no errors, and the onboarding container should now work on macOS.

        "contents": "    private var isInBackground: Bool {\n        #if canImport(UIKit)\n        return UIApplication.shared.applicationState == .background\n        #else\n        return false // macOS doesn't have background state in the same way\n        #endif\n    }\n    \n    // Log der letzten Updates (Dummy-Implementierung, sollte mit echten Daten aus LocationManager ersetzt werden)\n    private var updateLog: [LocationManager.UpdateLogEntry] {\n        locationManager.updateLog\n    }\n\n    private func speedText(for location: CLLocation) -&gt; String {\n        let metersPerSecond = location.speed\n        if metersPerSecond &gt;= 0 {\n            let kilometersPerHour = metersPerSecond * 3.6\n            return String(format: \"%.1f km/h\", kilometersPerHour)\n        } else {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"Unknown\", comment: \"Unknown speed value in Location Tracking Details\")\n        }\n    }\n\n    private var batteryLevelText: String {\n        #if canImport(UIKit)\n        let device = UIDevice.current\n        let wasMonitoringEnabled = device.isBatteryMonitoringEnabled\n        if !wasMonitoringEnabled { device.isBatteryMonitoringEnabled = true }\n        defer { if !wasMonitoringEnabled { device.isBatteryMonitoringEnabled = false } }\n        let level = device.batteryLevel\n        if level &lt; 0 {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"Unknown\", comment: \"Unknown battery level in Location Tracking Details\")\n        }\n        let percent = Int(level * 100)\n        return \"\\(percent) %\"\n        #else\n        return NSLocalizedString(\"Unknown\", comment: \"Unknown battery level in Location Tracking Details\")\n        #endif\n    }\n\n    private func altitudeText(for location: CLLocation) -&gt; String {\n        let verticalAccuracy = location.verticalAccuracy\n        if verticalAccuracy &gt;= 0 {\n            return String(format: \"%.1f m\", location.altitude)\n        } else {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"Unknown\", comment: \"Unknown altitude value in Location Tracking Details\")\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// MARK: - Daily reset helpers\nextension iPhone_LocationStatusView {}\n\n// MARK: - Supporting Views",

0 {\n                    Button(\"Previous\") { currentPage -= 1 }\n                }\n                Spacer()\n                if currentPage &lt; pages.count - 1 {\n                    Button(\"Next\") { currentPage += 1 }\n                } else {\n                    Button(\"Finish\") {\n                        UserDefaults.standard.hasCompletedOnboarding = true\n                        isPresented = false\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            .padding()\n        }\n        .background(Color(NSColor.controlBackgroundColor))\n        .ignoresSafeArea()\n        .background(Color(NSColor.controlBackgroundColor).ignoresSafeArea())\n    }\n}\n\nstruct Mac_OnboardingContainerView_Previews: PreviewProvider {\n    @State static var isPresented = true\n    @State static var currentPage = 0",

        "contents": "    /// and clamping of ratios to keep numerics stable when the device is far outside the region.\n    private func coordinateToScreenPoint(_ coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D) -&gt; CGPoint {\n        // Epsilon in degrees to prevent division by near-zero spans (≈ stability only).\n        let eps: CLLocationDegrees = 1e-9\n\n        let latDelta = max(mapRegion.span.latitudeDelta, eps)\n        let lonDelta = max(mapRegion.span.longitudeDelta, eps)\n\n        // Optional: unwrap longitude difference across the dateline so that long diffs prefer the short arc.\n        let dLon = deltaLongitude(coordinate.longitude, mapRegion.center.longitude)\n        let dLat = coordinate.latitude - mapRegion.center.latitude\n        \n        let latRatioRaw = CGFloat(dLat / latDelta)\n        let lonRatioRaw = CGFloat(dLon / lonDelta)\n\n        // Proportionally scale ratios so the largest magnitude fits within the screen bounds.\n        let maxScreens: CGFloat = 4\n        let maxRatio = max(abs(latRatioRaw), abs(lonRatioRaw))\n        let scale = (maxRatio &gt; maxScreens) ? (maxScreens / maxRatio) : 1\n        let latRatio = latRatioRaw * scale\n        let lonRatio = lonRatioRaw * scale\n\n        let screenX = screenCenter.x + lonRatio * screenSize.width\n        let screenY = screenCenter.y - latRatio * screenSize.height // Inverted Y axis\n        \n        // Debug: Print coordinate conversion details\n        debugLog(\"🌍 Device \\(deviceName) coordinate: \\(coordinate.latitude), \\(coordinate.longitude)\")\n        debugLog(\"🗺️ Map region center: \\(mapRegion.center.latitude), \\(mapRegion.center.longitude)\")\n        debugLog(\"📏 Map span: \\(mapRegion.span.latitudeDelta), \\(mapRegion.span.longitudeDelta)\")\n        debugLog(\"📊 Ratios (raw/scaled): lat=\\(latRatioRaw)→\\(latRatio), lon=\\(lonRatioRaw)→\\(lonRatio)\")\n        debugLog(\"🖥️ Screen center: \\(screenCenter), screen size: \\(screenSize)\")\n        debugLog(\"🎯 Calculated screen position: \\(screenX), \\(screenY)\")\n        \n        return CGPoint(x: screenX, y: screenY)\n    }\n    ",

\"\"\n        let country = device.country ?? \"\"\n        let combined = [locality, country].filter { !$0.isEmpty }.joined(separator: \", \")\n        if combined.isEmpty {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"widget_location_unknown\", comment: \"Shown when no placemark is available for the widget\")\n        }\n        return combined\n    }\n\n    private func formattedDistance(to device: WidgetDeviceData, from ownDevice: WidgetDeviceData?) -&gt; String {\n        guard let own = ownDevice else {\n            return NSLocalizedString(\"widget_distance_unknown\", comment: \"Shown when distance cannot be calculated\")\n        }\n        let deviceLocation = CLLocation(latitude: device.latitude, longitude: device.longitude)\n        let ownLocation = CLLocation(latitude: own.latitude, longitude: own.longitude)\n        let meters = deviceLocation.distance(from: ownLocation)\n        return distanceFormatter.string(fromDistance: meters)\n    }\n\n    private var distanceFormatter: MKDistanceFormatter {\n        let formatter = MKDistanceFormatter()\n        formatter.units = .default\n        formatter.unitStyle = .abbreviated\n        return formatter\n    }\n\n    private func formattedUpdateTimestamp(for date: Date) -&gt; String {\n        let label = NSLocalizedString(\"widget_last_update\", comment: \"Prefix for last update timestamp\")\n        let now = Date()\n        let stamp: String\n        if Calendar.current.isDate(date, inSameDayAs: now) {\n            stamp = date.formatted(date: .omitted, time: .shortened)\n        } else {\n            stamp = date.formatted(date: .abbreviated, time: .shortened)\n        }\n        return \"\\(label) \\(stamp)\"\n    }\n}\n\nstruct DeviceLocationMapWidget: Widget {\n    var body: some WidgetConfiguration {\n        ",

        "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * DeviceHistoryFormatters.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 2025-12-24.\n * Shared formatters and utilities for device history timeline views\n */\n\nimport SwiftUI\n\n/// Shared date formatters for device history timeline views\nenum DeviceHistoryFormatters {\n    static let timelineDateFormatter: DateFormatter = {\n        let formatter = DateFormatter()\n        formatter.dateStyle = .short\n        formatter.timeStyle = .short\n        return formatter\n    }()\n    \n    static let timelineTimeFormatter: DateFormatter = {\n        let formatter = DateFormatter()\n        formatter.dateStyle = .none\n        formatter.timeStyle = .short\n        return formatter\n    }()\n    \n    static let timelineDayFormatter: DateFormatter = {\n        let formatter = DateFormatter()\n        formatter.dateStyle = .short\n        formatter.timeStyle = .none\n        return formatter\n    }()\n}\n\n/// Shared color utility for device history timeline views\nenum DeviceHistoryColors {\n    /// Returns a color for a given ratio (0.0 = oldest/blue, 1.0 = newest/red)\n    static func historyColor(for ratio: Double) -&gt; Color {\n        let clamped = min(max(ratio, 0), 1)\n        // Older points blue, newer red\n        return Color(hue: 0.6 - 0.6 * clamped, saturation: 0.9, brightness: 0.9)\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "        let latDelta = max(region.span.latitudeDelta, 1e-9)\n        let lonDelta = max(region.span.longitudeDelta, 1e-9)\n\n        let dLon = deltaLongitude(coordinate.longitude, region.center.longitude)\n        let dLat = coordinate.latitude - region.center.latitude\n\n        let xRatio = CGFloat(dLon / lonDelta).clamped(to: -4...4)\n        let yRatio = CGFloat(dLat / latDelta).clamped(to: -4...4)\n\n        let x = center.x + xRatio * screenSize.width\n        let y = center.y - yRatio * screenSize.height\n        return CGPoint(x: x, y: y)\n    }\n\n    private static func rotate(point: CGPoint, around center: CGPoint, degrees: Double) -&gt; CGPoint {\n        let radians = degrees * .pi / 180\n        let translatedX = point.x - center.x\n        let translatedY = point.y - center.y\n        let cosA = cos(radians)\n        let sinA = sin(radians)\n        let x = translatedX * cosA - translatedY * sinA + center.x\n        let y = translatedX * sinA + translatedY * cosA + center.y\n        return CGPoint(x: x, y: y)\n    }\n\n    private static func deltaLongitude(_ lon: CLLocationDegrees, _ center: CLLocationDegrees) -&gt; CLLocationDegrees {\n        var d = lon - center\n        if d &gt; 180 { d -= 360 }\n        if d &lt; -180 { d += 360 }\n        return d\n    }\n}\n\nprivate extension Comparable {\n    func clamped(to range: ClosedRange&lt;Self&gt;) -&gt; Self {\n        return min(max(self, range.lowerBound), range.upperBound)\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "    private func overlay(for device: WidgetDeviceData, family: WidgetFamily) -&gt; some View {\n        let locality = formattedLocality(for: device)\n        let distance = formattedDistance(to: device, from: entry.ownDevice)\n        let lastUpdate = formattedUpdateTimestamp(for: device.timestamp)\n\n        let primaryComponents = [device.name, locality, distance].filter { !$0.isEmpty }\n        let primaryLine = primaryComponents.joined(separator: \" • \")\n        let (primaryFont, secondaryFont, spacing, padding) = overlayMetrics(for: family)\n\n        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: spacing) {\n            Text(primaryLine)\n                .font(primaryFont)\n                .lineLimit(1)\n                .minimumScaleFactor(0.6)\n                .shadow(radius: 2)\n            Text(lastUpdate)\n                .font(secondaryFont)\n                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)\n                .lineLimit(1)\n                .minimumScaleFactor(0.6)\n        }\n        .foregroundColor(.primary)\n        .padding(.vertical, padding)\n        .padding(.horizontal, padding + 2)\n        .background(\n            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10)\n                #if canImport(UIKit)\n                .fill(Color(UIColor.systemBackground).opacity(family == .systemMedium ? 0.7 : 0.4))\n                #else\n                .fill(Color(NSColor.controlBackgroundColor).opacity(family == .systemMedium ? 0.7 : 0.4))\n                #endif\n        )\n    }\n\n    private func overlayMetrics(for family: WidgetFamily) -&gt; (Font, Font, CGFloat, CGFloat) {\n        switch family {\n        case .systemMedium:\n            return (.subheadline.weight(.semibold), .caption2, 2, 7)\n        case .systemLarge:\n            return (.headline, .subheadline, 3, 12)\n        default:\n            return (.subheadline.weight(.semibold), .caption, 2, 8)\n        }\n    }\n\n    private var overlayWidthFactor: CGFloat {\n        switch family {\n        case .systemMedium: return 0.9",

        "contents": "    }\n\n    private func compute(region: MKCoordinateRegion, width: CGFloat) {\n        let usesMetric: Bool\n        if #available(iOS 16.0, *) {\n            usesMetric = Locale.current.measurementSystem == .metric\n        } else {\n            usesMetric = Locale.current.usesMetricSystem\n        }\n\n        // Bucket inputs to reduce recomputations and re-renders from tiny changes\n        let spanBucket = Self.bucketSpan(region.span.longitudeDelta)\n        let centerLatBucket = Self.bucketLatitude(region.center.latitude)\n        let widthBucket = Self.bucketWidth(width)\n        let key = CacheKey(spanBucket: spanBucket, centerLatBucket: centerLatBucket, widthBucket: widthBucket, isMetric: usesMetric)\n\n        if key == lastCacheKey {\n            return // Nothing significant changed\n        }\n\n        // Compute the raw distance for the given width\n        let distance = Self.distanceForWidth(region: region, width: width)\n        let label = Self.distanceLabel(for: distance)\n\n        DispatchQueue.main.async { [weak self] in\n            guard let self else { return }\n            self.lastCacheKey = key\n            self.label = label\n        }\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Helpers\n\n    private static func bucketSpan(_ span: CLLocationDegrees) -&gt; Int {\n        // Log-scale bucket to keep the same bucket across tiny changes; 2 decimals in log10 space\n        let clamped = max(span, .leastNonzeroMagnitude)\n        let logScaled = log10(clamped)\n        return Int((logScaled * 100.0).rounded())\n    }\n\n    private static func bucketLatitude(_ latitude: CLLocationDegrees) -&gt; Int {\n        // Bucket by 1 degree; distance per longitude varies with cos(latitude)\n        return Int(latitude.rounded())\n    }\n\n    private static func bucketWidth(_ width: CGFloat) -&gt; Int {\n        // Pixel-level bucket\n        return Int(width.rounded())\n    }\n\n    private static func distanceForWidth(region: MKCoordinateRegion, width: CGFloat) -&gt; CLLocationDistance {\n        // Calculate the distance that 'width' points cover on the map",

visibilityMargin ||\n            deviceScreenPoint.x &gt; screenSize.width - visibilityMargin ||\n            deviceScreenPoint.y &lt; visibilityMargin ||\n            deviceScreenPoint.y &gt; screenSize.height - visibilityMargin\n        \n        debugLog(\"🔍 Device \\(deviceName) is outside screen: \\(isOutsideScreen) (visibilityMargin: \\(visibilityMargin))\")\n        \n        guard isOutsideScreen else {\n            debugLog(\"❌ Device \\(deviceName) is inside screen bounds, no arrow needed\")\n            return nil\n        }\n        \n        // Calculate arrow position on screen edge with intelligent spacing\n        let arrowPosition = calculateIntelligentEdgePosition(deviceScreenPoint: deviceScreenPoint)\n        \n        // Calculate rotation angle to point towards device\n        let rotation = calculateRotationAngle(from: arrowPosition, to: deviceScreenPoint)\n        \n        debugLog(\"✅ Showing arrow for \\(deviceName) at position: \\(arrowPosition) with rotation: \\(rotation)\")\n        \n        return (position: arrowPosition, rotation: rotation)\n    }",

Created native Mac implementations for both views:

1. **Mac_DeviceMapView** — Mac-native device map view with:
   - Map display with device marker
   - Location fetching and auto-update
   - Edit, navigation, and history actions
   - Error handling
   - Map controls (scale bar, compass)

2. **Mac_DeviceNavigationView** — Mac-native navigation view with:
   - Route calculation between user and device
   - Route display on map
   - Travel time and distance display
   - Route reversal toggle
   - Open in Apple Maps integration
   - Auto-update functionality

Both views:
- Use macOS-specific APIs (wrapped in `#if os(macOS)`)
- Use `NSColor` instead of `UIColor` where needed
- Follow the same patterns as the iOS versions but adapted for macOS
- Include error handling and loading states

Also updated `mapStyleFromSettings` to include macOS 14.0+ availability.

The linter shows no errors, so these should compile and work on macOS.

Fixed all macOS-specific issues:

1. **Removed `authorizedWhenInUse` check** — macOS only supports `.authorizedAlways` for location permissions, so removed the iOS-only check.

2. **Removed unused `annotationID` variable** — it was defined but never used.

3. **Replaced `.symbolEffect(.rotate)` with `.rotationEffect()`** — `.rotate` requires macOS 15.0+, so replaced it with `.rotationEffect()` that works on all macOS versions. The animation still rotates the refresh icon when updating.

4. **Simplified history sheet** — removed the unused `device` variable check.

All linter errors are resolved. The views should compile and work on macOS. The refresh button animation uses a rotation effect compatible with all macOS versions.

Fixed all issues:

1. **Created `Mac_GroupDetailView`** — Native Mac group detail view with:
   - Group name editing
   - Device list with checkmarks
   - Context menu for editing devices
   - Uses `Form` instead of `List` for Mac styling

2. **Created `Mac_GroupMapView`** — Native Mac group map view with:
   - Map display showing all devices in the group
   - Location fetching and auto-update
   - Device markers with timestamps
   - Context menu for device actions
   - Auto-zoom to fit all devices
   - Error handling

3. **Fixed type-checking issue in `Mac_GroupsView`** — Broke up the complex expression on line 55 by extracting `isSelected` into a separate variable, which helps the Swift compiler type-check the expression.

All views:
- Use macOS-specific APIs (wrapped in `#if os(macOS)`)
- Use `NSColor` instead of `UIColor` where needed
- Follow Mac UI patterns (Form instead of List, etc.)
- Include error handling and loading states

The linter shows no errors, so these should compile and work on macOS.
